title: The Bad Air
text: The candles gutter, shrink, and burn blue. Your breath comes short and your heartbeat loud in your ears. The air down here is thin and wrong, and it tastes of old pennies, and the dead rats along the wall all died facing the way you came.

options.label: Hold your breath and hurry through, before the air takes hold of you.

outcomes.text: Lungs burning, vision going grey at the edges, everyone makes it. Barely.
Someone breathes. The air gets inside their head and starts rearranging things, and it does not put them back.

options.label: The sharpest nose follows a faint draught, hoping it leads to clean air.

outcomes.text: A side passage, clean air, and something someone hid there, long ago, for a day like this.

options.label: Turn back and find another way. Whatever killed those rats is still in the air.

outcomes.text: Another way, longer, and the taste of old pennies stays in your mouths all the way.
